BUSINESS STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   D. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Cash Flow Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Cash Flow Statement as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Flow Statement.
   C. Say Cash Flow Statement never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Cash Flow Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Foreign Exchange Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Foreign Exchange Markets as rumours only.
   B. Say Foreign Exchange Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Foreign Exchange Markets.
   D. Explain Foreign Exchange Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. Which statement about Networking in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Networking in Business.
   B. Explain Networking in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Networking in Business as rumours only.
   D. Say Networking in Business never happens in Kenya.

5. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Avoid saving forever
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

6. Which statement about Insurance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Insurance as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Insurance.
   C. Explain Insurance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Insurance never happens in Kenya.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Kisumu
   C. Mombasa
   D. Nairobi

8. Which statement about Money Markets is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Money Markets with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Money Markets never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Money Markets as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Money Markets.

9. Which statement about Statement of Financial Position is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statement of Financial Position as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statement of Financial Position.
   C. Say Statement of Financial Position never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statement of Financial Position with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   B. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.
   D. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Destroying road signs
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Littering in markets

13. Which statement about End - Of - Year Adjustments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain End - Of - Year Adjustments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say End - Of - Year Adjustments never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing End - Of - Year Adjustments.
   D. Treat End - Of - Year Adjustments as rumours only.

14. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Explain symbols used on a map
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Replace the compass rose
   D. Name the president

15. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.
   B. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   D. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

16. Which statement about Income Statement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Income Statement as rumours only.
   B. Say Income Statement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Income Statement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Income Statement.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain End - Of - Year Adjustments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Insurance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Foreign Exchange Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Money Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Inflation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Economic Integration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain National Income and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Types of Business Ownership and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Networking in Business and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
